title: Hero Stone
brief_description: Virgal stone depicting in upper row the shivpuja, in the middle portion a dance and in the lower portion a person is shown (broken in three pieces)
detailed_description: Broken Viragal in three panels punctuated by decorative crossbars. All three panels are broken.The lowermost panel which usually illustrates the cause of hero's death is broken. The middle panel represents the hero being carried to heaven by a mob of apsaras. The uppermost panel depicts the hero seated in heaven, worsipping a shivalinga; a person, probably a dwarpalaka holding a sword and a shield is guarding him. This memorial stone can be assigned to 13th cent. A.D. (later phase of Goa Kadambas) because the heads of the figures increase disproportionately to the size of their bodies.
